Wisconsin Frat Leaders Arrested in Alleged Hazing Incident

Authorities in Wisconsin arrested fraternity leaders after discovering approximately 30 pledges in a basement described as filthy and sweltering. The pledges were found injured and partially clothed, covered in condiments and other food items. Police are investigating the incident as alleged hazing.
